query: plain white shirt size M under 2000
sql: SELECT parent_asin FROM shirts WHERE (CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(color, '')) || '|', '|white|') AND pattern IN ('plain') AND CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(sizes, '')) || '|', '|m|') AND price_inr_est < 2000) AND (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(color, ''))) = 'white' AND pattern = 'plain')
SELECT parent_asin FROM shirts WHERE CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(sizes, '')) || '|', '|xxl|') AND price_inr_est < 1500
